model_system: 2D kagome-lattice giant-unit-cell model for AV3Sb5 cLC state (pure-type b3g/3dXZ orbital sector) with a single unitary impurity in the triple-Q charge loop current phase

key_params.cLC_order: pure imaginary hopping modulation delta t^C_{ij} = +/- i eta on nearest-neighbor bonds
key_params.cLC_pattern: triple-Q, 2x2 enlarged unit cell with 12 sites
key_params.giant_unit_cell: Mx x My copies of 12-site cell, up to Mx = My = 10
key_params.impurity_type: single-site unitary-limit impurity/vacancy defect on an A site
key_params.impurity_positions: Imp1 on triangular loop, Imp2 on hexagonal loop; random impurity gives 50% each

headline_claim: The orbital-magnetization suppression ratio R = -Delta M_orb / M_orb^0 can exceed 50% upon introducing 1% impurities.
replication_difficulty: high - requires reproducing the authors' specific triple-Q imaginary-hopping pattern and large real-space impurity calculation of current, orbital magnetization, and anomalous Hall response on up to 1200-site supercells.
